{{Quote|Incompetent, unimaginative oaf. The only reason he holds a command at all is that so many officers above him defected to Fel.|Vul Isen|<ref name="Legacy 32" />}}
'''Sturves''' was a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] in [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] who participated in the [[Skirmish on Dac]]. He commanded the [[Acklay-class mobile fortress|Acklay Battle Fortress]], ''[[Sea Lion]]'', as he and his battle group attempted to track down and exterminate [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] refugees.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I want those fishheads executed!|Sturves about the [[Mon Calamari Rangers]]|<ref name="Legacy 32" />}}
According to [[One Sith|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]], Sturves was an incompetent commander who started his career in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] at a relatively low rank. He eventually was promoted to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] following the [[Attack on Emperor Fel|coup]] by [[Darth Krayt]]. When many officers in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] defected to the overthrown [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] and joined his [[Empire-in-exile]], there was a gap in the hierarchy, and Sturves was promoted to fill the gap, despite lacking the skills needed for the position. As a Commander, Sturves was placed in charge of an [[Acklay-class mobile fortress]] dubbed the ''[[Sea Lion]]''.<ref name="Legacy 32" />

Following Emperor Darth Krayt's decree that ten percent of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] were to be eliminated, with the rest being sent to extermination camps, Sturves and the crew of the ''Sea Lion'' were sent on a mission to track down Mon Calamari civilians that had fled into the oceans of the planet. Sturves' group came upon a settlement of Mon Calamari refugees, and he ordered [[Shark Squadron]], a unit of [[Shark underwater fighter|Shark]] subfighters, to destroy the camp. However, [[Mon Calamari Rangers]] under the command of [[Tanquar]], appeared in their [[Krakana underwater fighter|Krakana fighter craft]] to protect the defenseless civilians. When Shark Squadron began to take casualties, Sturves ordered [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Troax]] to send [[Aquatic assault stormtrooper|seatroopers]] into the water to defeat the Rangers. [[Alpha Squadron (seatrooper)|Alpha Squadron]] was sent to deal with the threat, but they were attacked by [[Imperial Knight]] [[Treis Sinde]]. Sinde quickly destroyed the group, and then boarded the ''Sea Lion''.<ref name="Legacy 32" />

Sturves was unprepared for Sinde's assault, and the Imperial Knight destroyed the ''Sea Lion''{{'s}} [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]], causing the ship to flood. Not wishing to lose his ship, Sturves prepared to leave the battlefield. Lieutenant Troax recalled Shark Squadron to cover their retreat, and Sturves was able to escape to effect repairs to his damaged vessel. Following this, Sturves submitted a report of the incident to [[Darth Azard]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who had been placed in charge of the massacre. Azard and Sith scientist, Vul Isen had been busy creating a [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawned]] creature, the [[Sea Leviathan]]. Based on Sturves' report, the Sith knew the general location of the Mon Calamari Rangers, and decided to use the Sea Leviathan in that area to draw out their enemy.<ref name="Legacy 32" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sturves first appeared in the [[2009]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[Legacy (2006) 32|''Legacy'' (2006) 32]], the first issue of ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''{{'s}} [[Star Wars: Legacy: Fight Another Day|''Fight Another Day'']] story arc.<ref name="Legacy 32" />
